The '''Rhinnal system''' was an eight-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Ringali Shell]]. It contained the planet of [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]].
